When the grid goes down, your work doesn’t stop. From milking 
systems and grain storage to heating and water pumps, reliable 
electricity is critical. In the countryside, power cuts aren’t just 
inconvenient — they can be dangerous. From stopped milking 
systems to vulnerable livestock and lost communications, 
downtime costs more than money.
Mecc Alte PTO generators provide you with dependable backup 
We build from the heart of your power system – the alternator 
– and our PTO systems are trusted by thousands of farmers 
across Europe and the world.
Mecc Alte PTO generators offer a simple, reliable solution that 
gives you peace of mind 365 days a year.

THE PTO GENERATOR RANGE IS A 
TRACTOR-DRIVEN POWER UNIT
This includes an alternator with control box, a reduction 
frame. These units are designed to provide reliable back-up 
power in the event of a power failure.
Driven by a tractor’s power take-off, they are equipped 
with a sturdy frame which connects by means of a three-
point linkage. Characterised by proven high performance 
levels, robust construction with maximum reliability, they 
have an exceptional starting capacity for electric motors, 
ensuring they meet the harshest demands when power is 
needed most.

SMARTER CONTROL.
SAFER POWER.
MORE USABLE POWER, FULLY PROTECTED
When the grid goes down, you need every kilowatt your tractor can give, without putting your alternator, milking
system or water pumps at risk. The PTO250 is a dedicated controller developed by Mecc Alte specifically for our
PTO generators. It can be set to your alternator’s rated current, monitors the supply while it runs, and opens the
main circuit breaker if it detects an abnormal operating condition.
USE ALL THE POWER YOU PAID FOR
Standard circuit breakers only come in fixed sizes. A 50 kVA
PTO generator at 400 V delivers around 72 A, so a standard
63 A or 80 A breaker may either limit the usable output or not
provide suitable protection. The PTO250 can be set to your
alternator’s actual rated current, helping you use the available
power without compromising protection.
PROTECTION THAT KEEPS WATCH
Tractor engine speed changes as the load changes. The
PTO250 continuously monitors the main electrical and
operating parameters. If speed or voltage moves outside the
set limits, it automatically opens the main circuit breaker,
helping to prevent damage to the alternator and connected
equipment.
FIND FAULTS FASTER
Clear symbols and codes on the display help show what
happened. The built­in log records alarms, events and
operating conditions, so your dealer can find the cause of a
fault faster and plan maintenance more effectively.
BUILT FOR THE FARM
Developed specifically for tractor­driven power, not adapted
from a generic panel. Sealed to IP65 (with gasket) and rated
from ­30°C to +60°C, ready for the yard, the barn and the
field. Set­up and updates by USB, with free configuration
software.
